# FDG5088

> DO NOT provide a conversion operator if such a conversion is not clearly expected by the end users.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.7.2 Conversion Operators.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

Not checked: whether users expect a conversion needs user research or prior art, as the body says.

## From the book

Ideally, you should have some user research data showing that the conversion is expected, or some prior art examples where a similar type needed such conversion.
